caption:
Mortgage rates are heading the wrong way 🏠

Freddie Mac's weekly survey had the average 30-year fixed rate at 7.40% for the week of Oct. 15, up from 7.03% on Sept. 24.

On a typical loan, even a small rate change shifts the monthly payment a lot.

Are you waiting on buying a home, or already locked in?
first_comment: What monthly housing payment feels 'too much' to you? 👇
